stories.name: Biology volunteer
stories.story: Enjoys biology investigations and explaining things to people. Wants to observe patient care before committing to medicine.

reasons: Find out how the human body works and why people get sick.
Help someone feel comfortable during a difficult day.
Help a classmate understand something they have been struggling with.
Listen carefully to different perspectives on a difficult issue.
Look for an explanation when the results of an experiment surprise you.
Compare different explanations and find evidence that supports one.

plan.preparation: Bachelor’s degree + MD or DO + family medicine residency

nextSteps.title: Explore a health question
nextSteps.detail: Use two reliable sources to explain a general health question. Notice whether you enjoy the science, explanation, or both. Use a public youth program for supervised exposure to healthcare.

nextSteps.title: Map college, medical school, and residency
nextSteps.detail: Compare college prerequisites, four-year medical training, and family medicine residency. Budget each stage separately; no college major guarantees medical school admission.

nextSteps.title: Ask about a normal day in family medicine
nextSteps.detail: Ask a physician and a resident about patient contact, documentation, training hours, and what they wish they knew in high school.
